title: Petrol economy and fuel use
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly discuss favorable petrol economy and lower-than-expected fuel use, with a few complaints about disappointing consumption or the petrol-only offering and several fragments that mention fuel type or use without a clear opinion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise efficient petrol consumption, lower running costs, and using less fuel than expected.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize disappointing petrol consumption and dissatisfaction that the model is only offered as petrol rather than diesel.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention petrol or lower fuel use but do not provide enough context to confirm a clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: Several fragments are very short or context-limited, so some mentions of lower fuel use or petrol type remain undetermined rather than clearly evaluative.
One positive example refers to diesel being cheaper while petrol prices rise, which is related to running costs but not directly to petrol consumption for this model.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
